name: Staten Island Ferry Ridership Counts
description: This dataset contains daily passenger counts for the Staten Island Ferry, with one row per date and separate totals for the Whitehall Terminal in Manhattan and the St. George Terminal in Staten Island. Each record includes a date and two numeric ridership figures, covering roughly 2,900 days with about 2.5% of terminal values missing. Counts range from roughly 1,500 to 49,000 passengers per terminal per day, with typical values around 15,000 to 25,000. The data can be used to track ridership trends over time, compare demand in each direction, spot weekday, seasonal, or holiday patterns, and support transit planning, capacity management, and scheduling.
